entries.title: Rambo loader — main music
entries.description: Martin Galway's 1985 loading music, independently reconstructed by SID Song Crafter as an editable symbolic score and computed C64 player. This main-music entry omits the Morse introduction and retains the original ending.

listening.status: Underlying characteristic phrase and natural ending accepted
listening.scope: On 2026-10-13 the listener heard no audible difference in the characteristic phrase and natural ending comparisons of the complete reconstruction. This is not a full-song perceptual comparison, PCM identity or hardware equivalence. The new cold-start entrance is not separately listening-reviewed. The reference WAV is a render of this reconstructed main-entry SID, not an original recording.

annotations.title: Restored main entry
annotations.description: Entry time zero corresponds to source play call 1586. The computed score and sound-program state are retained; SID envelopes, oscillators and filter history start fresh. The package records the lead starting on the next frame. This is a newly initialized performance, not a crop of the complete WAV.

annotations.title: The score streams return
annotations.description: Source calls 10544, 10559 and 10560 end the score streams for physical voices 2, 3 and 1. Returning from the score clears its active bit; each voice's separate sound lifetime continues to be processed. Times are rebased from source call 1586 at the declared PAL cadence.

annotations.title: Sound processing continues after the score
annotations.description: Final register stores for physical voices 1, 2 and 3 occur at source calls 10660, 10799 and 10814; the source stops producing SID stores from call 10815. The lifetime path can continue pitch and pulse motion after score return. These execution facts do not measure the audible release or prove an isolated stem.

entries.description: J. S. Bach’s BWV 565 Toccata, reduced to three SID voices with moving pulse instruments and driven organ phrasing; ends before the Fugue.

entries.title: Rambo loader — main music, stereo
entries.description: Martin Galway's loading music in SID Song Crafter's centered-lead two-SID arrangement, with independent accompaniment on each chip. The main entry omits the original introduction and retains the ending; SID A goes left and SID B goes right.

rights.attribution: Composed, arranged and programmed by Martin Galway, 1985; historical credit: (C) Ocean Software 1985. Galway's upstream README dated 2026-04-14 states that he acquired the music/programming rights from Infogrames. Modified version: SID Song Crafter's independent symbolic score and computed two-SID player, packaged 2026-10-15, with source-derived held harmony, a duplicated native lead and bounded sync/ring modulator handoffs; the main-entry modification is dated 2026-10-16. The combined score, SID and generated WAV are distributed under GNU GPL version 3, without warranty; separately used independently authored tools retain their MIT license.

listening.status: Main-entry stereo release accepted on 2026-10-16; complete arrangement verdict retained
listening.scope: On 2026-10-16 the listener accepted the presented trimmed Rambo stereo WAV alongside the complete Bach Toccata stereo WAV. This main-entry release has fresh SID envelopes, oscillators and filter history and is not promised to match a crop of the complete render. The reference is the generated two-SID performance; this source verdict does not establish Explorer or hardware playback acceptance.

entries.title: Bach Toccata — complete Toccata section, stereo
entries.description: The complete BWV 565 Toccata section redistributed across two SID chips: the melody is duplicated at center, bass goes left and harmony goes right. Notes, instruments and timing retain the mono arrangement; SID A goes left and SID B goes right.
